name: ACEP26 Scientific Assembly
description: The ACEP Scientific Assembly is the American College of Emergency Physicians' annual educational meeting for emergency medicine. ACEP26 takes place at McCormick Place in Chicago and includes the ACEP Research Forum.

Confirms Research Forum abstract submission opening date of March 4, 2026; does not list closing date
